listing.title: Electric Foil Shavers for Men: 4 Floating Blades & Big LED Display

bullets.text: 4-Blade Floating Precision: Engineered with 4 independent floating blades, the foil shavers for men contour to the jaw, chin, and neck in a single pass, capturing flat-lying hairs that fixed-heads miss. Each flexes for consistent skin contact

IPX7 Waterproof: The shaver is perfectly at home in a steamy shower or on a bathroom counter. Designed as a versatile electric razor for men, the unit transitions effortlessly between wet and dry use, and the sealed body rinses clean under running water

Compact Travel Ready: Charging via the universal USB-C port - One cable powers the shaver alongside phones and laptops. The palm-sized body fits a toiletry bag or carry-on. Your mini electric shaver includes a protective cap that shields for transit

LED Display & Dual Speed: A built-in LED screen displays remaining battery level at a glance, preventing mid-shave power loss. This electric shaver paired with 2 selectable speed modes, the lower for sensitive skin, while the higher for thicker growth

Thoughtful Gift Grooming Essential: This electric razor ready to use straight from the box with intuitive one-button operation. The compact make it a practical choice for birthdays or Father's Day, delivered as a thoughtful self-contained solution
